A peripheral IV cannula used for intermittent access should be flushed with saline before and after each medication or blood draw, and at least every 8–12 hours when it is left saline-locked, following your facility's policy. Heparin is no longer routinely required for peripheral lines in most settings. If you meant a different type of cannula, such as an arterial line or a central line, the interval differs.

CONFIDENCE: 70
